template.body:
<root charset="utf-8">
    <text align="center" size="wide" font="bold">{{sites.name}}</text>
    <text align="center">{{sites.addressLine1}}</text>
    <text align="center">{{sites.addressLine2}}</text>
    <separator char="-" />
    
    <text>Order #: {{orders.docNumber}}</text>
    <text>Date: {{dateOfPrinting}}</text>
    <text>Staff: {{staff.firstName}} {{staff.lastName}}</text>
    <text>Register: {{registers.name}}</text>
    <separator char="-" />
    
    <docket-section>
        <text font="bold">{{name}}</text>
        <text>  Qty: {{quantity}} @ ${{unitPrice}}</text>
        <text>  Total: ${{totalAmount}}</text>
    </docket-section>
    
    <separator char="=" />
    <text align="right" size="wide">Total: {{currencies.currencySymbol}}{{orders.totalAmount}}</text>
    <text align="right">Tax: {{currencies.currencySymbol}}{{orders.taxAmount}}</text>
    
    <blank lines="2" />
    <text align="center">Thank you for your order!</text>
    <text align="center">{{sites.phone}}</text>
    
    <blank lines="3" />
    <command cmd="cut" />
</root>
